cake.module.fullbright.name: Full Bright
cake.module.timechanger.name: Time Changer
cake.module.timechanger.description: Overrides the client-side time of day. Lighting follows the selected time.
cake.setting.timechanger.time.name: Time
cake.setting.timechanger.time.descriptio: Time of day in ticks, from 0 to 23999. 0 is sunrise, 6000 noon, 12000 sunset, and 18000 midnight.
cake.module.blockoutline.name: Block Outline
cake.module.blockoutline.description: Customizes the block outline with a border, overlay, and chroma.
cake.setting.blockoutline.border.name: Border
cake.setting.blockoutline.border.descrip: Draws an outline around the block you are looking at. The vanilla high contrast outline is overridden while the module is enabled.
cake.setting.blockoutline.border_color.d: Color and opacity of the border.
cake.setting.blockoutline.border_thickne: Scales the width of the border.
cake.setting.blockoutline.overlay.name: Overlay
cake.setting.blockoutline.overlay.descri: Fills the shape of the block you are looking at.
Color and opacity of the overlay.
cake.setting.blockoutline.chroma.name: Chroma
cake.setting.blockoutline.chroma.descrip: Animates the hue of the border and overlay colors over time.
cake.setting.blockoutline.chroma_speed.d: How fast the colors cycle. 1x is one full cycle every five seconds.
cake.module.smoothfont.name: Smooth Font
cake.module.smoothfont.description: Replaces the default font with a smooth, high-resolution font.
cake.module.cleanscoreboard.name: Clean Scoreboard
cake.module.cleanscoreboard.description: Hides the score numbers on the scoreboard sidebar.
cake.module.fps.name: FPS
cake.module.fps.description: Shows your frames per second on the HUD.
cake.module.cps.name: CPS
cake.module.cps.description: Shows your clicks per second on the HUD.
cake.module.ping.name: Ping
cake.module.ping.description: Shows your server latency on the HUD.
cake.module.zoom.name: Zoom
cake.module.zoom.description: Zooms the camera in while enabled. Use the scroll wheel to adjust the zoom level.
cake.setting.zoom.zoom.name: Zoom
cake.setting.zoom.zoom.description: How far the camera zooms in. The scroll wheel adjusts this while zooming.
cake.module.fingerprint.name: Fingerprint Protection
cake.module.fingerprint.description: Hides client details that servers can use to fingerprint you.
cake.setting.fingerprint.brand.name: Spoof Brand
cake.setting.fingerprint.brand.descripti: Reports the vanilla client brand instead of the modded one.
cake.setting.fingerprint.channels.name: Hide Mod Channels
cake.setting.fingerprint.channels.descri: Stops mod network channels from being registered or sent. This breaks modded servers that rely on custom channels.
cake.setting.fingerprint.translations.de: Blocks mod translation keys in server text so servers cannot detect installed mods through signs and books.
cake.setting.fingerprint.keybinds.name: Hide Keybinds
cake.setting.fingerprint.keybinds.descri: Shows default keys for vanilla keybinds and raw names for mod keybinds in server text.
cake.setting.fingerprint.pack_cache.name: Isolate Pack Cache
cake.setting.fingerprint.pack_cache.desc: Stores server resource packs per account so servers cannot link your accounts through the cache.
cake.setting.fingerprint.local_packs.des: Rejects resource pack downloads that point to local addresses, which servers can use to scan your network.
cake.module.screenshotcompression.name: Screenshot Compression
cake.module.screenshotcompression.descri: Compresses screenshots into smaller PNG, WebP, JPEG, JPEG XL, or AVIF files.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.forma: Image format to save screenshots in.
Lossless keeps every pixel exact. Lossy makes smaller files by dropping some detail. PNG is always lossless, and JPEG is always lossy.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.quali: Quality for lossy formats: lower is smaller, higher looks better.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.match: Save screenshots at your window's size. On scaled displays this avoids oversized files.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.png_l: How hard to work to shrink PNG files. Higher saves more space but takes a little longer. Used when the output format is PNG.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.webp_: How hard to work to shrink WebP files. Higher saves more space but takes longer. Used when the output format is WebP.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.avif_: How fast to encode AVIF. Faster makes larger files; slower makes smaller, better-looking ones. Used when the output format is AVIF.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.jxl_e: How hard to work to shrink JPEG XL files. Higher saves more space but takes longer. Used when the output format is JPEG XL.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.use_e: Use extra image encoders installed on your system for better compression, when available. AVIF and JPEG XL always need external encoders.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.prefe: When a system encoder can handle the format, use it instead of the built-in one.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.avif_: Command or path for the AVIF encoder.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.webp_: Command or path for the WebP encoder.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.png_o: Command or path for the PNG optimizer.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.jpeg_: Command or path for the JPEG encoder.
cake.setting.screenshotcompression.jxl_e: Command or path for the JPEG XL encoder.
cake.module.discordrichpresence.name: Discord Rich Presence
cake.module.discordrichpresence.descript: Shows your Minecraft activity on your Discord profile. Requires the Discord desktop app.
cake.setting.discordrichpresence.show_se: Shows the name and icon of the server you are on, including supported server integrations and public servers listed in Lunar Client's ServerMappings.
cake.hud.editor.title: HUD Editor
cake.hud.editor.hint: Drag to move, release near a snap point to anchor, or click a snap point. Drag the corner to scale.
